# Gold Sample

`gold_sample.csv` is intentionally empty at repository creation. Populate it
from stratified parser output before any public release:

- at least 50 listings per year;
- at least 100 listings per year for 1998, 2000, and 2001;
- oversample page boundaries, multi-line addresses, co-located programs,
  unusual service codes, and records carrying parser warnings.

Set `review_complete=yes` only after comparing the row to the PDF image.
